This '''glittering dust''' was used by [[Hohass Ekwesh]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], against a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]] during the unit's [[Mission to Chashima|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]]<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].</ref> Ekwesh threw the dust toward the young [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Hohass Ekwesh victim)|warrior's]] head, temporarily blinding him. However, the warrior still managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the injured Wraith [[Estoric Sandskimmer]] with his [[amphistaff]] before Ekwesh killed him with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="MK" />
